name: pokeidle-hub
description: Painel pessoal para acompanhar 4 contas do PokeIdle.
author: André Narcizo <andre.narcizo@sysout.com.br>

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @pokeidle-hub/api" "npm run start -w @pokeidle-hub/web"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @pokeidle-hub/api && npm run build -w @pokeidle-hub/web && npm run build -w @pokeidle-hub/extension
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @pokeidle-hub/api && playwright test --trace off
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && tsc -p e2e/tsconfig.json
